//: The import map for the browser bundle, on the published jsr releases. @polymorph/iroh instantiates components under @polyengine/runtime, so ONE resolved copy of the runtime graph-wide keeps `isComponentException` brand checks and stateful handles valid across every boundary (the sibling @polymorph host modules couple only to @polyengine/protocol as of the 0.5.0 line -- A22 -- but the constraint still binds through @polymorph/iroh and our own entry). Multiple copies is a real, previously-observed failure mode in this component family (errors stop being recognisable across a module boundary and surface as unbranded throws).

Exact pins, not ranges: the runtime and the translator wasm (which scripts/site-deploy-tree.sh ships from the SAME @polyengine release) share a plan format, and a range that drifted one without the other would skew them. Bumps are deliberate: change the pin here and TRANSLATOR_VERSION/TRANSLATOR_SHA256 in site-deploy-tree.sh together. Note: as of @polymorph/iroh 0.5.1 the @polymorph packages depend on jsr:@polyengine/runtime@^0.5.1, so our exact pin must stay on that minor line for the one-copy resolution to hold.

minimumDependencyAge keeps Deno's default supply-chain gate for everything else while letting these exactly-pinned component-family releases resolve on their publish day (the same convention the polymorph packages' own deno.jsons use).
